yawn_yes: Visible yawn: from clear onset of yawning mouth/jaw motion to return toward baseline. Not arbitrary speech or every open mouth.
yawn_no: Watched interval with no visible yawn; include reviewed speech, laughter and normal mouth motion as hard negatives when distinguishable.
eyes_open: Eyes visibly open. Does not imply global alertness or absence of yawning.
eyes_closed: Eyes visibly closed, including blinks. Does not itself diagnose sleep or microsleep.
distraction_none_visible: Sufficient visible context to rule out the four target action categories; not proof of gaze on road, alertness or safety.
phone_use: Visible evidence of using/holding a phone for a call or texting.
drinking: Visible drinking action. Eating requires separate source evidence and annotation review before merging.
other_object: Visible mapped radio adjustment, reaching, grooming or other specified object activity; explain the action in notes.
passenger_interaction: Evidence of passenger-directed interaction; mouth opening or talking alone is insufficient. Record supporting context in notes.
yawn_uncertain: Cannot reliably distinguish yawning from other mouth activity.
distraction_uncertain: Action or required hand/object/passenger context is ambiguous.
yawn_not_visible: Mouth/jaw evidence is not adequately visible.
eyes_not_visible: Eye region is not adequately visible.
distraction_not_visible: Required driver/hand/object context is not adequately visible.
